headline: WATCH comes to phones — and the flood spell learns restraint
lede: Slot a resumed a half-finished ship, found why it had been stuck for an hour (a duplicated YAML key meant CI never ran at all), and landed both watch-phone UX and the honest DISSOLVE clamp on production — then filed the merge-loop hardening the incident exposed.

notes.text: Phones finally get WATCH: one solid 44pt ▶ WATCH pill taps start AND watch across 29 titles, the pause menu gained a WATCH row, and the banner keeps its thumb gap under the taller pill. FloorBoss's pill finally cleared the thumb-stick zone.

The real ship-blocker was invisible: ci.yml carried a duplicated `if:` key from an auto-merge, GitHub refused to parse it, and zero check-runs made `static` look eternally pending. Two pushes, two silent workflow deaths before a YAML parse caught it.

DISSOLVE — MagicCarpet's 11th spell — shipped as a lava bomb wearing a flood's clothes: a mutant clamp line cratered every cell in the radius, invisible to CI. Restored to the honest local flood, four named gates green, mutant re-proven red to green.
A lane-swap plus a merge loop that outlived its own timeout merged the wrong PR through a shim branch-inference hole. Full forensics posted on #1671; merge-safety hardening filed as #1676.
